history_summary: Record three species-reference GTDB correspondences and complete Priestia ambiguity for Quinoa SCDY1 descriptors.
history_details: The pinned native crosswalk supports Pseudomonas panipatensis, Fictibacillus_C enclensis and Bacillus atrophaeus reference populations of five, nine and 127 genomes with fraction 1.0, plus all four ordered Priestia megaterium alternatives. Preserve nine partial-16S species-like study isolates, stock labels, all source quotations and the Arabidopsis host versus quinoa-origin distinction. Four existing grounded blocks and the native-null Sphingomonas descriptor remain unchanged. The existing Acidovorax block reports 375 genomes while the fresh diagnostic reports 324; this add-only correction neither refreshes nor certifies that unselected block. Selected preprint excerpts are not a complete article/supplement audit, and the inherited reciprocal-benefit/source limits remain. Database reference populations do not identify study assemblies or inoculum abundance. Only three blocks, four statuses, one option list and two native inline events changed; the one host node and zero arrows remain intact. Crosswalk release and chronology are unestablished. This partial technical correction does not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
